name: TFF - Futures Only
description: This is a report of futures only positions. The Traders in Financial Futures (TFF) report includes financial contracts. The TFF report breaks down the reported open interest into five classifications: Dealer, Asset Manager, Leveraged Money, Other Reportables and Non-Reportables.
queryString:

  `market_and_exchange_names`,

  `conc_gross_le_8_tdr_short`,

  `conc_net_le_4_tdr_short_all`,
  `conc_net_le_8_tdr_long_all`,
  `conc_net_le_8_tdr_short_all`,
  `contract_units`,
  `cftc_subgroup_code`,
  @ph.`commodity_name` AS `commodity`,
  @ph.`commodity_subgroup_name`,
  @ph.`commodity_group_name`,
  `futonly_or_combined`
LEFT OUTER JOIN @rj6x-va3z AS @ph ON `cftc_contract_market_code`
                                       = @ph.`contract_market_code`
WHERE `futonly_or_combined` = 'FutOnly'
